args.task: Open the Ada Lovelace article, follow its link to Charles Babbage, and report the year Charles Babbage was born.
steps: Find the link to Charles Babbage in the article.
args.done_when: Charles Babbage's birth year is reported from his own article.

args.task: Open the comments page of the story ranked number 1 and report how many comments it has and the username of the first commenter.
args.done_when: The comment count and the first commenter's username are reported.

args.task: Find a Head tennis racket and add one to the cart, then stop with the cart showing it. Do not check out.
steps: Open the first racket in the results.
Stop when the cart shows it.
args.done_when: The cart shows one Head tennis racket.

args.task: Find the cheapest one-way flight from Zurich to London on 20 December and report the airline, departure time and price.
steps: Set the trip to one way.
Enter Zurich as the origin and London as the destination.
args.done_when: The cheapest flight's airline, time and price are reported.

args.task: Search Zara for linen shirts, open the first men's linen shirt and report its price and which sizes are available.
args.done_when: The first linen shirt's price and available sizes are reported.

args.task: Find a sleeveless tennis top on On's site and report its name, price and the sizes offered.
args.done_when: A sleeveless tennis top's name, price and sizes are reported.

args.task: Search eBay for mechanical keyboard, sort the results by price plus shipping lowest first, and report the title and price of the first listing.
args.done_when: Results are sorted lowest price first and the first listing's title and price are reported.

args.task: Find three spicy chicken dishes that deliver to ZIP code 92618 and report each dish, restaurant and price.
args.done_when: Three spicy chicken dishes with restaurant and price are reported.

args.task: Search Stack Overflow for python list comprehension and report the title and vote count of the first result.
args.done_when: The first result's title and votes are reported.

args.task: Find a recipe for classic banana bread and list its ingredients.
args.done_when: The ingredients of one banana bread recipe are listed.
